SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-16-2020 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JAN-05-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. IF NO APPEARANCE THIS CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF WHEELS FINANCIAL GROUP, LLC, REPRESENTED BY DINUSHI GUNARATNE, COLLECTIONS REPRESENTATIVE IS PRESENT VIA COURTCALL. DEFENDANT AYANNA BANKS IS PRESENT. PARTIES ENTERED INTO A STIPULATED SETTLEMENT IN WHICH DEFENDANT BANKS (BANKS) WILL PAY PLAINTIFF WHEELS FINANICAL GROUP, LLC (WFG) A TOTAL SUM OF $2,685.50. BANKS WILL PAY WFG $150.00 ON THE 16TH OF EVERY MONTH BEGINNING OCTOBERT 16, 2020 THROUGH JANUARY 16, 2022. FINAL PAYMENT OF $286.50 IS DUE ON FEBRUARY 16, 2022. WFG MAY SEEK A FORMAL JUDGMENT FOR THE FULL AMOUNT OF MONIES WITH CREDIT FOR MONIES PAID SHOULD BANKS FAIL TO TIMELY MAKE PAYMENTS. AN APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED TO INFORM THE COURT OF THE STATUS OF THIS AGREEMENT. IF PAYMENTS ARE BEING MET TO THE TERMS OF THE AGREEMENT, THE COURT WILL SET ANOTHER PROGRES REPORT DATE EVERY 3 MONTHS TILL THE AGREEMENT IS MET. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
